Enterprise means depth: larger, more complex accounts with more revenue at stake. Each account is a global legal function with multiple teams, jurisdictions and business units, its own governance, and a long, multi-phase roadmap. Success depends on navigating that complexity: aligning General Counsel, legal operations, IT, security and procurement, and building momentum one team and one use case at a time until Legora is used across the whole function. At the heart of the role is designing each client's enterprise adoption strategy and delivering the change programmes that transform how they work. For every account you will build a tailored, multi-year roadmap, sequence initiatives from the first pilot teams to function-wide and global adoption, define measurable outcomes and ROI with executive sponsors, and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge. You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class enterprise adoption programme at Legora, helping clients realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work. WHAT YOU'LL DO You'll lead the post-sale customer experience, owning onboarding, adoption and long-term value realisation for a portfolio of enterprise accounts. Specifically, you will: - Design each client's enterprise adoption strategy: the change-management approach, governance model, stakeholder map across legal, business and IT, and target outcomes for how that legal function adopts Legora. - Execute against that strategy, sequencing initiatives from the first pilot teams through to function-wide and global adoption across regions, practice areas and business units. - Build and run executive governance with each client, including steering committees, executive business reviews and success plans owned jointly with GC and legal operations leadership. - Act as a strategic adviser who deeply understands enterprise in-house legal priorities (cost, cycle time, risk, global cons

We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. Getting that right is one of the most critical and complex challenges at Legora. Every jurisdiction holds billions of pages of critical legal text scattered across hundreds of sources – statutes, case law, regulatory guidance, secondary materials, and more. Only about 3% is publicly accessible on the web. The rest is buried across courts, agencies, and archives. Getting this right doesn't just improve a product feature — it shapes how lawyers around the world navigate legal information for the next several decades. As a Legal Data Analyst at Legora, you will own this challenge. You will be the person who is responsible for mapping the legal source ecosystem, determining and prioritizing what we go after, and how this content shall be structured and systematized — the one who makes sure we actually get legal data right. Few roles at the company will have more direct impact on Legora AI’s ability to navigate the law correctly. What you will be doing: - Map the legal data landscape across key jurisdictions — structuring how statutes, case law, secondary sources, and regulatory content interrelate, building a clear picture of what exists, where it lives, and how it connects - Conduct deep dives into individual sources, assessing available material, document types, commercial value, and the legal preconditions for data acquisition - Prioritise data acquisition based on client demand, user value, and Legora's broader data coverage strategy - Serve as the critical link between legal knowledge and our engineering teams — translating the nuances of each source into actionable briefs that enable our engineers to get the most out of every dataset - Own the quality and accuracy of the legal data layer that underpins Legora's global legal research product Who you are - You are a detail-oriented lawyer with an exceptional track record — academically, professionally, or both - You are excited about what AI is doing to the legal industry and you want to be close to that shift - You find
